title: Complexity and Scale in AI-Assisted Workflow Management: A Federated Learning Case Study
abstract: arXiv:2606.18425v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Federated learning over medical images is a demanding workflow application. Each round fans out across parallel client jobs and converges on an aggregation step that feeds the next round. At scale this yields 101 sub-workflows and 2,679 jobs on GPUs at four sites, which takes an expert months to build, mostly on workflow mechanics rather than science. We ask how far AI assistance can automate such workflows. An LLM agent, grounded in a released plugin of Pegasus-specific skills, first produces a reviewable specification of checkable constraints and acceptance criteria, then generates the executable workflow. A validation loop repairs runtime failures, checks code against those constraints, and regenerates the implementation from the specification alone. translated_title: AI辅助工作流管理中的复杂性与规模：一个联邦学习案例研究
translated_abstract: 在医学图像上开展联邦学习是一项要求很高的工作流应用。每一轮训练会在并行的客户端任务中展开，然后汇聚到为下一轮提供输入的聚合步骤。在规模化场景下，这会产生101个子工作流和分布在四个站点GPU上的2,679个任务，专家需要花费数月时间来构建，且大部分精力消耗在工作流机制而非科学研究上。我们探讨了AI辅助能在多大程度上自动化这类工作流。一个基于已发布的Pegasus特定技能插件的LLM智能体，首先生成一份包含可检查约束和验收标准的可审查规范，随后生成可执行的工作流。一个验证循环负责修复运行时故障、对照这些约束检查代码，并仅依据规范重新生成实现。我们评估了三个LLM智能体，报告了在FABRIC测试平台上的端到端运行结果，并展示了针对规范的符合性检查如何捕获了三个故障检测手段无法发现的静默错误。
tldr: 该研究通过基于Pegasus技能插件的LLM智能体，采用“规范生成—工作流生成—验证修复”的循环流程，成功自动化构建了跨四个站点、包含101个子工作流和2,679个GPU任务的联邦学习工作流，并证明规范符合性检查能捕获故障检测无法发现的静默错误。
en_tdlr: This study demonstrates that an LLM agent grounded in a Pegasus skill plugin can automate the construction of a federated learning workflow spanning four sites with 101 sub-workflows and 2,679 GPU jobs through a specification-generation-validation loop, with conformance checking against the specification catching silent errors that failure detection alone would miss.
